tier_reason: Real independent client for a platform with no wrapper alternative (no vanilla-widget equivalent exists for native mobile) -- unlike react/angular this SDK is not redundant with anything, so it stays actively invested even though it currently has the widest gaps of the 5 'core' SDKs.
last_verified_by: contract audit: every SDK path diffed against server routes + gateway map, plus per-SDK wire tests

chat.evidence: flutter/lib/src/resources/chat_resource.dart -- get/list/create/close/getMessages/sendMessage/markAsRead; test/chat_contract_test.dart. sendTyping is on ErghiClient (hub), not the resource.

inbox.note: Workspace surface (member access token), never the visitor surface. Workspace API keys cannot hold view_conversations/manage_inbox_settings/manage_contacts (not grantable), so they get 403. Contacts, notifications, @mentions and unassign require platform PR #256 (not merged when this was written).
